findings.title: Inter as the default font

evidence.snippet: font-family: Inter, sans-serif | first family is Inter

findings.fix: Use the system stack (system-ui, then the platform faces) or the brand face, not Inter.
findings.why: Inter as the first family is the default face of generated UI and flattens every page into the same voice.

findings.title: Text below WCAG AA contrast

evidence.snippet: #ffffff on #ec4899 = 3.53:1, needs 4.5:1 (background #ec4899 from .icon; font-size 22px)

findings.fix: Darken the text token or lighten the surface until the pair clears 4.5:1.
findings.why: Body text under 4.5:1 (or 3:1 for large text) is unreadable for a large share of users.

evidence.snippet: border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) | literals: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)

findings.fix: Declare these as custom properties in the token block and reference them with var().

findings.title: More than one accent hue family
